raw_segments.text: Through the mysterious agency which works in schools and among servants, it was quite
well known in the morning that Sarah Crue was in horrible disgrace, that Ermingard was
under punishment, and that Becky would have been packed out of the house before breakfast,
but that a scullery maid could not be dispensed with at once. The servants knew that she was
allowed to stay because Miss Minchin could not easily find another creature helpless
and humble enough to work like a bounden slave for so few shillings a week.
The elder girls in the schoolroom knew that if Miss Minchin did not send Sarah away,
it was for practical reasons of her own.
